delta.note: Fixed regular income is taken as base salary, fixed allowances, other regular income and regular taxable benefits in kind, measured in the first employment month of 2025 (January for earlier hires); employer KLU, NPWP/NIK integration and receipt of other DTP are read from case attributes. Over-withholding at year end is refunded only to the extent it exceeds the DTP already granted, and for employer-borne tax the DTP is paid to the employee as cash through a negative tax burden.

output.reason: Grants a PPh 21 'ditanggung pemerintah' (government-borne) facility for the 2025 tax periods. It covers certain permanent employees (Pegawai Tetap) of employers in labour-intensive industries (footwear, textiles and apparel, furniture, leather) with the KLU codes listed in Lampiran A. Eligible permanent employees must have fixed, regular gross income of at most Rp10,000,000. The PPh 21 must be paid in cash to the employee, and that cash payment is not counted as taxable income. Any excess incentive is not refunded to the employee. Together these change the PPh 21 net-pay calculation for permanent employees.
